meta.name: agency-docs-updater
meta.description: This skill should be used when updating ~/Sites/agency-docs meeting documentation after Claude Code lab sessions. Automatically creates/updates meeting MDX files with Fathom links, YouTube embeds, fact-checked summaries using claude-code-guide agent, and presentation content. Auto-detects lab number from filename, finds presentations, commits and pushes changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动更新会议文档并推送变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次实验课后都要手动更新会议文档
copy.tagline_en: Automatically update meeting docs and push changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update meeting docs after each lab session

howto.what: 自动为 Claude Code 实验室会议创建或更新 MDX 格式的文档，包含 Fathom 链接、YouTube 嵌入、经事实核查的摘要和演示文稿内容，并自动提交推送。
howto.when: 完成 Claude Code 实验室会议、视频已上传 YouTube、Fathom 转录存在于 Obsidian 仓库后，需要更新 ~/Sites/agency-docs 中的会议文档时触发。

say.text: 运行脚本更新会议文档，指定 Fathom 文件、YouTube 链接和摘要。
say.note: 自动创建或更新 MDX 文件。

say.text: 更新现有会议文件，指定编号 07 并添加 --update 标志。

howto.what_en: Automatically creates or updates MDX meeting documentation for Claude Code lab sessions, including Fathom links, YouTube embeds, fact-checked summaries, and presentation content, then commits and pushes changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered after completing a Claude Code lab session, when video is uploaded to YouTube, Fathom transcript exists in Obsidian vault, and you need to update meeting docs in ~/Sites/agency-docs.

say_en.text: Use @claude-code-guide to create a fact-checked summary from the Fathom transcript.
say_en.note: Generates summary and saves to summary.md.

say_en.text: Run the update script with Fathom file, YouTube URL, and summary file.
say_en.note: Auto-creates or updates the MDX file.

say_en.text: Update existing meeting file with number 07 and --update flag.
